root_cause: New root-level branch integration pages and their regression test were initially absent from the website delivery classifier.
tests/branche-applicaties-integraties.test.mjs existed but was not executed by any CI workflow.
Portal V2 received an additional top-level desktop navigation item although the feature belongs under the existing Data/Koppelingen route and the contract requires ten desktop items.
Production Source Snapshot depended on NETLIFY_MCP_PROXY_PATH_TEMP; the stored GitHub Actions secret had expired and Netlify returned 401 Unauthorized.
prevention_rules: Every committed regression test must be executed by at least one CI workflow before merge.
New public root-level pages must be registered in the delivery classifier in the same candidate.
Reuse the existing Data/Koppelingen Portal route unless a deliberate navigation contract change is required.
Treat temporary Netlify MCP proxy paths as expiring credentials; a 401 is a fail-closed production blocker and never production proof.
Do not claim LIVE_BEWEZEN without exact protected-main SHA readback from production.
Persist exact Netlify provider identity as immutable checkpoint evidence, while keeping required functional browser proof as a separate gate that must be resumed if cancelled.
